name: Israel
standard: IS 5568 (Israeli Standard, based on WCAG 2.0) at Level AA

laws.cite: Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, 5758-1998
laws.summary: Framework disability-rights law under which the service accessibility regulations are made.

laws.cite: Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013, reg. 35
laws.summary: Internet service providers, public and private, must make websites, documents and apps meet IS 5568 AA.

applies_to: Public authorities and private businesses offering services online, with turnover-based exemptions for small businesses.

deadlines.what: Documents prepared after this date must be accessible (per summary)

exceptions: Businesses under NIS 100,000 turnover exempt; NIS 100k–1m partial exemptions for existing sites
Technical impossibility exemptions, valid up to 3 years with professional review
requires: IS 5568 Level AA for text, documents, images, video on websites and apps
Accessibility statement with accessibility coordinator contact
Remediate within 60 days of a complaint
mobile: explicit — the regulation's 'internet service' definition includes applications.
enforcement: The Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities enforces; civil suits including class actions. Statutory damages up to NIS 50,000 are reported by secondary sources.
notes: The only source opened is Access Israel (NGO), not a government primary. The office URL, the IS 5568 WCAG version (2.0 vs later revision) and the damages figure are unverified. Law URLs point to the Access Israel explainer because no official English text was opened.
